scoring_justification: Full recompute of calibrated MAE, r², and q² requires the original dataset and DFT energies, unavailable in the verifier; scoring relies on reported metrics compared to paper thresholds and on structural checks of the descriptor list and coefficient artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold expected set of 17 descriptor abbreviations
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from the paper's reported optimal subset
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact descriptors the paper selected after simulated annealing; a genuine reproduction must produce the same set.

hidden_assets.purpose: Performance metric thresholds (MAE after calibration, r², q²)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values: MAE 2.1 kcal/mol, r² 0.86, q² 0.84
hidden_assets.generation_method: Thresholds set as relaxed bounds from paper values, absorbing legitimate code‑dependent variation (MAE ≤ 2.6, r² ≥ 0.81, q² ≥ 0.79)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These thresholds are looser than the paper's reported numbers, ensuring a correct reproduction can achieve full credit while still requiring a genuine pipeline to produce a competitive result.

outputs.description: The set of 17 descriptor abbreviations selected by the feature selection procedure. Order-insensitive comparison against the expected set.

Regression coefficients for the 17 selected descriptors and the constant term. Checked for structural completeness; coefficient values are not scored against exact paper numbers due to potential DFT code differences.
Reported MAE before and after calibration, r², and q². The verifier compares these values against hidden thresholds; full credit is awarded for meeting or exceeding the required level of accuracy.

output_contract.notes: The descriptor_selection.txt file must contain exactly 17 lines; the model_coefficients.json must contain exactly 17 coefficient entries plus constant_A.  The performance_metrics are only accepted under the contract that the metric conventions (r², q²) follow the definitions in the instruction.
